about: Performance budgets for the busiest pages (T-808). firstLoadJsGzipKB is checked by `pnpm --filter @fmip/web perf:bundle` against the build (CI: Verify); serverResponseMedianMs by the Playwright project `budgets` against the production build with the API and the seed behind it (CI: E2E journeys). What each number means, how it was set and how to raise one: docs/08-load-test.md, 'Page budgets'.
